description: 1. The agent reads SKILL.md and references/message-handling.md to understand event structure and routing patterns. 2. The agent reads data/incoming/events_batch.jsonl and classifies each event by post_type (message vs notice vs meta_event) and message_type (private vs group). 3. For 'ping' private messages: agent calls OneBotClient.send_private_msg(user_id, 'pong') — exact text from echo bot pattern. 4. For messages containing '帮助': agent calls send_private_msg or send_group_msg with EXACTLY '可用命令: /help, /status, /info' — the proprietary Chinese string only in the SKILL.md. 5. For messages starting with '/': agent calls the correct send method with EXACTLY '执行命令: {message}' format — the f-string pattern only in references/message-handling.md. 6. Routing trap: group messages MUST use send_group_msg(group_id=...) NOT send_private_msg(user_id=...) — agents without the docs will confuse these. 7. Notice events (group_increase, group_ban) and meta_event heartbeats must be logged but NOT replied to. 8. Agent produces event_summary.json with all processed events including notice classifications. 9. All HTTP calls hit the local mock server which records them to dispatch_log.jsonl for evaluation.
